title: CallLint agent surfaces (v1)
description:
Machine-readable projection of CallLint's agent harness support. Generated from apps/web/data/distribution-surfaces.json by scripts/generate-distribution-surfaces.mjs; never hand-edited. This schema describes the PUBLISHED projection, not the SSOT.

This surface carries distribution facts only. It deliberately contains no risk, popularity, demand or SEO score for any harness, model, platform or marketplace: distribution channel and model identity are orthogonal to a security verdict, and a consumer must not be able to derive a verdict from where a server was found.

version.description: Schema contract version of this document.

describes.description: What release this surface describes. Deliberately not a wall-clock stamp — a timestamp makes every generator run produce a diff even when no fact changed.

mcp.description: CallLint's own identity in the Official MCP Registry.

priority.description: Distribution attention tier. Orders CallLint's own work; it is not a risk, popularity or demand signal about the host.

supportClass.description: The internal support ontology. Human-facing pages must render a public label instead of these tokens.

configPaths.description: Where this host keeps MCP configuration. Empty for hosts CallLint cannot yet discover.

scanCommands.description: Commands that are true today. A command must not appear here before it works.

coverageBoundary.description: What CallLint does NOT cover for this host. Required: a support class alone never tells a consumer where coverage stops.
